sanskrit: dasyubhyo vañcakebhyo vā rājan prati parasparam rājavallabhataś caiva nāśrūyanta mṛṣā giraḥ
english: O king, from thieves or deceivers, or from one another, or even from those favoured by the king — false words were not heard.

sanskrit: avarṣaṃ cātivarṣaṃ ca vyādhipāvakamūrchanam sarvam etat tadā nāsīd dharmanitye yudhiṣṭhire
english: Drought, excessive rain, epidemic, and devastation by fire — all of this was absent when Yudhiṣṭhira was devoted to dharma.

sanskrit: priyaṃ kartum upasthātuṃ balikarma svabhāvajam abhihartuṃ nṛpā jagmur nānyaiḥ kāryaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak
english: To do him honour, to attend upon him, and to present their natural tribute, kings came separately — not for any other business.

sanskrit: dharmyair dhanāgamais tasya vavṛdhe nicayo mahān kartuṃ yasya na śakyeta kṣayo varṣaśatair api
english: Through righteous means of acquiring wealth, his treasury grew vast — a treasury whose depletion could not be accomplished even in hundreds of years.

sanskrit: svakośasya parīmāṇaṃ koṣṭhasya ca mahīpatiḥ vijñāya rājā kaunteyo yajñāyaiva mano dadhe
english: Having gauged the extent of his treasury and granary, the king, the son of Kuntī, directed his mind solely toward the sacrifice.

sanskrit: suhṛdaś caiva taṃ sarve pṛthak ca saha cābruvan yajñakālas tava vibho kriyatām atra sāṃpratam
english: All his well-wishers, separately and together, said to him: "O lord, the time for your sacrifice has come — let it now be performed."

sanskrit: athaivaṃ bruvatām eva teṣām abhyāyayau hariḥ ṛṣiḥ purāṇo vedātmā dṛśyaś cāpi vijānatām
english: While they were saying this, Hari arrived — the ancient sage, the embodiment of the Vedas, visible only to those with true knowledge.

sanskrit: jagatas tasthuṣāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ prabhavaś cāpyayaś ca ha bhūtabhavyabhavannāthaḥ keśavaḥ keśisūdanaḥ
english: The foremost of all beings, moving and stationary, both the origin and dissolution of the world, the lord of what was, what will be, and what is — Keśava, the slayer of Keśin.

sanskrit: prākāraḥ sarvavṛṣṇīnām āpatsv abhayado 'rihā balādhikāre nikṣipya saṃhatyānakadundubhim
english: The rampart of all the Vṛṣṇis, the giver of fearlessness in times of calamity, the slayer of foes — having placed the great drum in the charge of Bala and set out with force —

sanskrit: uccāvacam upādāya dharmarājāya mādhavaḥ dhanaughaṃ puruṣavyāghro balena mahatā vṛtaḥ
english: Mādhava, that tiger among men, taking with him wealth of every kind — high and low — for the Dharma-king, came attended by a great army.

sanskrit: taṃ dhanaugham aparyantaṃ ratnasāgaram akṣayam nādayan rathaghoṣeṇa praviveśa purottamam
english: Resounding with the roar of his chariot, he entered the best of cities, bringing that boundless flood of wealth, that inexhaustible ocean of jewels.

sanskrit: asūryam iva sūryeṇa nivātam iva vāyunā kṛṣṇena samupetena jahṛṣe bhārataṃ puram
english: As a sunless place rejoices at the arrival of the sun, as a windless space rejoices at the coming of the wind — so did the Bhārata city rejoice at the arrival of Kṛṣṇa.

sanskrit: taṃ mudābhisamāgamya satkṛtya ca yathāvidhi saṃpṛṣṭvā kuśalaṃ caiva sukhāsīnaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: Yudhiṣṭhira went joyfully to meet him, honoured him according to due rite, enquired after his welfare, and when he was comfortably seated —

sanskrit: dhaumyadvaipāyanamukhair ṛtvigbhiḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ bhīmārjunayamaiś cāpi sahitaḥ kṛṣṇam abravīt
english: That bull among men, together with Bhīma, Arjuna, and the twins, and with the officiating priests headed by Dhaumya and Dvaipāyana, spoke to Kṛṣṇa:

sanskrit: tvatkṛte pṛthivī sarvā madvaśe kṛṣṇa vartate dhanaṃ ca bahu vārṣṇeya tvatprasādād upārjitam
english: "O Kṛṣṇa, the entire earth has come under my sway because of you; and much wealth too, O Vārṣṇeya, has been earned through your grace.

sanskrit: so 'ham icchāmi tat sarvaṃ vidhivad devakīsuta upayoktuṃ dvijāgryeṣu havyavāhe ca mādhava
english: I wish to employ all of that, O son of Devakī, according to the prescribed rites — for the foremost brāhmaṇas and in the sacrificial fire, O Mādhava.

sanskrit: tad ahaṃ yaṣṭum icchāmi dāśārha sahitas tvayā anujaiś ca mahābāho tan mānujñātum arhasi
english: I wish to perform the sacrifice, O Dāśārha, together with you and my younger brothers, O great-armed one — please grant me your permission.

sanskrit: sa dīkṣāpaya govinda tvam ātmānaṃ mahābhuja tvayīṣṭavati dāśārha vipāpmā bhavitā hy aham
english: Initiate yourself for the rite too, O Govinda, O great-armed one; for when you have sacrificed, O Dāśārha, I shall be freed of all sin.

sanskrit: māṃ vāpy abhyanujānīhi sahaibhir anujair vibho anujñātas tvayā kṛṣṇa prāpnuyāṃ kratum uttamam
english: Or grant your approval to me, together with my younger brothers, O lord; sanctioned by you, O Kṛṣṇa, I shall attain the highest sacrifice."

sanskrit: taṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ bahūktvā guṇavistaram tvam eva rājaśārdūla samrāḍ arho mahākratum saṃprāpnuhi tvayā prāpte kṛtakṛtyās tato vayam
english: Kṛṣṇa replied to him at length, extolling his many virtues: "You alone, O tiger among kings, are worthy of the great imperial sacrifice. Accomplish it — when you have attained it, we shall all have fulfilled our purpose."

sanskrit: yajasvābhīpsitaṃ yajñaṃ mayi śreyasy avasthite niyuṅkṣva cāpi māṃ kṛtye sarvaṃ kartāsmi te vacaḥ
english: "Perform the sacrifice you desire, with me standing by for your welfare. Employ me too in the task — I shall do everything you command."

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca saphalaḥ kṛṣṇa saṃkalpaḥ siddhiś ca niyatā mama yasya me tvaṃ hṛṣīkeśa yathepsitam upasthitaḥ
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: "O Kṛṣṇa, my resolve has borne fruit and my success is assured — for you, O Hṛṣīkeśa, have come to me just as I desired."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca anujñātas tu kṛṣṇena pāṇḍavo bhrātṛbhiḥ saha īhituṃ rājasūyāya sādhanāny upacakrame
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Permitted by Kṛṣṇa, the Pāṇḍava, together with his brothers, began to assemble the requisites for the Rājasūya sacrifice.

sanskrit: tata ājñāpayām āsa pāṇḍavo 'rinibarhaṇaḥ sahadevaṃ yudhāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mantriṇaś caiva sarvaśaḥ
english: Then the Pāṇḍava, crusher of enemies, commanded Sahadeva, foremost among warriors, as well as all his ministers in every respect:

sanskrit: asmin kratau yathoktāni yajñāṅgāni dvijātibhiḥ tathopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ maṅgalāni ca sarvaśaḥ
english: "For this sacrifice, all the constituent elements as described by the twice-born, all the requisite materials, and all the auspicious items in every respect —

sanskrit: adhiyajñāṃś ca saṃbhārān dhaumyoktān kṣipram eva hi samānayantu puruṣā yathāyogaṃ yathākramam
english: — and the sacrificial provisions as specified by Dhaumya — let men bring them quickly, in proper manner and in due order.

sanskrit: indraseno viśokaś ca pūruś cārjunasārathiḥ annādyāharaṇe yuktāḥ santu matpriyakāmyayā
english: Let Indrasena, Viśoka, and Pūru — Arjuna's charioteer — be engaged in the procurement of food and provisions, out of desire to please me.

sanskrit: sarvakāmāś ca kāryantāṃ rasagandhasamanvitāḥ manoharāḥ prītikarā dvijānāṃ kurusattama
english: And let all desired things be prepared — endowed with fine flavours and fragrance, pleasing and delightful for the twice-born, O best of the Kurus."

sanskrit: tad vākyasamakālaṃ tu kṛtaṃ sarvam avedayat sahadevo yudhāṃ śreṣṭho dharmarāje mahātmani
english: At the same time as those words were spoken, Sahadeva, foremost among warriors, reported to the great-souled Dharma-king that all had been done.

sanskrit: tato dvaipāyano rājann ṛtvijaḥ samupānayat vedān iva mahābhāgān sākṣān mūrtimato dvijān
english: Then, O king, Dvaipāyana assembled the officiating priests — twice-born men of great glory, embodied like the Vedas themselves made manifest.

sanskrit: svayaṃ brahmatvam akarot tasya satyavatīsutaḥ dhanaṃjayānām ṛṣabhaḥ susāmā sāmago 'bhavat
english: The son of Satyavatī himself took the role of Brahman-priest for the sacrifice; the bull of those who conquer wealth, Susāman, became the chanter of Sāmans.

sanskrit: yājñavalkyo babhūvātha brahmiṣṭho 'dhvaryusattamaḥ pailo hotā vasoḥ putro dhaumyena sahito 'bhavat
english: Yājñavalkya, most learned in sacred lore, became the foremost Adhvaryu priest; Paila, son of Vasu, together with Dhaumya, became the Hotṛ priest.

sanskrit: eteṣāṃ śiṣyavargāś ca putrāś ca bharatarṣabha babhūvur hotragāḥ sarve vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ
english: The disciples and sons of these priests, O bull of the Bhāratas, all became Hotṛ-chanters — all versed to the utmost in the Vedas and the Vedāṅgas.

sanskrit: te vācayitvā puṇyāham īhayitvā ca taṃ vidhim śāstroktaṃ yojayām āsus tad devayajanaṃ mahat
english: Having recited the auspicious day and having sought out the prescribed procedure as declared in the scriptures, they assigned the roles for that great divine sacrifice.

sanskrit: tatra cakrur anujñātāḥ śaraṇāny uta śilpinaḥ ratnavanti viśālāni veśmānīva divaukasām
english: There, commissioned by the king, craftsmen constructed halls and pavilions — vast and jewel-adorned, like the dwellings of the gods.

sanskrit: tata ājñāpayām āsa sa rājā rājasattamaḥ sahadevaṃ tadā sadyo mantriṇaṃ kurusattamaḥ
english: Then that king, best among kings, the best of the Kurus, immediately commanded his minister Sahadeva:

sanskrit: āmantraṇārthaṃ dūtāṃs tvaṃ preṣayasvāśugān drutam upaśrutya vaco rājñaḥ sa dūtān prāhiṇot tadā
english: "Dispatch swift messengers quickly for the purpose of sending invitations." Hearing the king's word, he sent out the messengers at once.

sanskrit: āmantrayadhvaṃ rāṣṭreṣu brāhmaṇān bhūmipān api viśaś ca mānyāñ śūdrāṃś ca sarvān ānayateti ca
english: "Invite throughout the kingdoms: brāhmaṇas, rulers of the earth, honoured members of the Vaiśya order, and all Śūdras — bring them all."

sanskrit: te sarvān pṛthivīpālān pāṇḍaveyasya śāsanāt āmantrayāṃ babhūvuś ca preṣayām āsa cāparān
english: By the command of the son of Pāṇḍu, those messengers invited all the protectors of the earth; and he dispatched others as well.

sanskrit: tatas te tu yathākālaṃ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram dīkṣayāṃ cakrire viprā rājasūyāya bhārata
english: Then, in due season, the brāhmaṇas initiated the son of Kuntī, Yudhiṣṭhira, for the Rājasūya sacrifice, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: dīkṣitaḥ sa tu dharmātmā dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ jagāma yajñāyatanaṃ vṛto vipraiḥ sahasraśaḥ
english: Thus initiated, the righteous-souled Dharma-king Yudhiṣṭhira proceeded to the sacrificial ground, surrounded by thousands of brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: bhrātṛbhir jñātibhiś caiva suhṛdbhiḥ sacivais tathā kṣatriyaiś ca manuṣyendra nānādeśasamāgataiḥ amātyaiś ca nṛpaśreṣṭho dharmo vigrahavān iva
english: That best of kings, accompanied by his brothers, kinsmen, friends, counsellors, ministers, and Kṣatriyas gathered from many lands, appeared like Dharma himself embodied, O lord of men.

sanskrit: ājagmur brāhmaṇās tatra viṣayebhyas tatas tataḥ sarvavidyāsu niṣṇātā vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ
english: Brāhmaṇas arrived there from various regions on all sides — deeply accomplished in all branches of learning, versed to the utmost in the Vedas and the Vedāṅgas.

sanskrit: teṣām āvasathāṃś cakrur dharmarājasya śāsanāt bahvannāñ śayanair yuktān sagaṇānāṃ pṛthak pṛthak sarvartuguṇasaṃpannāñ śilpino 'tha sahasraśaḥ
english: By the command of the Dharma-king, thousands of craftsmen built separate lodgings for them — each with abundant food and furnished with beds, fit for their various retinues, and endowed with the comforts of every season.

sanskrit: teṣu te nyavasan rājan brāhmaṇā bhṛśasatkṛtāḥ kathayantaḥ kathā bahvīḥ paśyanto naṭanartakān
english: In those lodgings, O king, the brāhmaṇas dwelt, greatly honoured, telling many stories and watching actors and dancers.

sanskrit: bhuñjatāṃ caiva viprāṇāṃ vadatāṃ ca mahāsvanaḥ aniśaṃ śrūyate smātra muditānāṃ mahātmanām
english: Of the brāhmaṇas as they ate and spoke with great sound, their joyful voices were heard ceaselessly there, O great soul.

sanskrit: dīyatāṃ dīyatām eṣāṃ bhujyatāṃ bhujyatām iti evaṃprakārāḥ saṃjalpāḥ śrūyante smātra nityaśaḥ
english: "Give, give to them! Let them eat, let them eat!" — such cries of this kind were constantly heard there.

sanskrit: gavāṃ śatasahasrāṇi śayanānāṃ ca bhārata rukmasya yoṣitāṃ caiva dharmarājaḥ pṛthag dadau
english: The Dharma-king separately bestowed hundreds of thousands of cows, O Bhārata, as well as beds and golden ornaments and women.

sanskrit: prāvartataivaṃ yajñaḥ sa pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ pṛthivyām ekavīrasya śakrasyeva triviṣṭape
english: Thus was commenced that sacrifice of the great-souled Pāṇḍava, the sole hero of the earth — like Indra's sacrifice in the three worlds.

sanskrit: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā preṣayām āsa pāṇḍavam nakulaṃ hāstinapuraṃ bhīṣmāya bharatarṣabha
english: Then King Yudhiṣṭhira sent the Pāṇḍava Nakula to Hāstinapura, O bull of the Bhāratas, to invite Bhīṣma.

sanskrit: droṇāya dhṛtarāṣṭrāya vidurāya kṛpāya ca bhrātṝṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ ye 'nuraktā yudhiṣṭhire
english: And also Droṇa, Dhṛtarāṣṭra, Vidura, Kṛpa, and all the brothers who were devoted to Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca sa gatvā hāstinapuraṃ nakulaḥ samitiṃjayaḥ bhīṣmam āmantrayām āsa dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca pāṇḍavaḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Going to Hāstinapura, Nakula the victorious in assembly, that Pāṇḍava, invited Bhīṣma and Dhṛtarāṣṭra.

sanskrit: prayayuḥ prītamanaso yajñaṃ brahmapuraḥsarāḥ saṃśrutya dharmarājasya yajñaṃ yajñavidas tadā
english: Having heard of the Dharma-king's sacrifice, those who were versed in sacrifice set out with glad hearts for the rite, preceded by brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: anye ca śataśas tuṣṭair manobhir manujarṣabha draṣṭukāmāḥ sabhāṃ caiva dharmarājaṃ ca pāṇḍavam
english: And others too, O bull among men, by the hundreds, with pleased minds, eager to see the assembly hall and the Pāṇḍava Dharma-king.

sanskrit: digbhyaḥ sarve samāpetuḥ pārthivās tatra bhārata samupādāya ratnāni vividhāni mahānti ca
english: From every direction, O Bhārata, all the kings converged there, bringing many and great jewels of various kinds.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca bhīṣmaś ca viduraś ca mahāmatiḥ duryodhanapurogāś ca bhrātaraḥ sarva eva te
english: Dhṛtarāṣṭra and Bhīṣma, Vidura of great intelligence, and all the brothers with Duryodhana at their head —

sanskrit: satkṛtyāmantritāḥ sarve ācāryapramukhā nṛpāḥ gāndhārarājaḥ subalaḥ śakuniś ca mahābalaḥ
english: — all duly honoured and invited, kings with preceptors at their head; the king of Gāndhāra, Subala, and the mighty Śakuni;

sanskrit: acalo vṛṣakaś caiva karṇaś ca rathināṃ varaḥ ṛtaḥ śalyo madrarājo bāhlikaś ca mahārathaḥ
english: Acala and Vṛṣaka; Karṇa, the best of chariot-warriors; Śalya, king of the Madras; and Bāhlika, the great chariot-warrior —

sanskrit: somadatto 'tha kauravyo bhūrir bhūriśravāḥ śalaḥ aśvatthāmā kṛpo droṇaḥ saindhavaś ca jayadrathaḥ
english: Somadatta of the Kuru line, Bhūri, Bhūriśravā, Śala, Aśvatthāmā, Kṛpa, Droṇa, and Jayadratha the king of Sindhu —

sanskrit: yajñasenaḥ saputraś ca śālvaś ca vasudhādhipaḥ prāgjyotiṣaś ca nṛpatir bhagadatto mahāyaśāḥ
english: Yajñasena with his sons, Śālva the lord of the earth, and Bhagadatta, king of Prāgjyotiṣa, of great fame —

sanskrit: saha sarvais tathā mlecchaiḥ sāgarānūpavāsibhiḥ pārvatīyāś ca rājāno rājā caiva bṛhadbalaḥ
english: Together with all the Mleccha peoples dwelling by the ocean shores, the mountain kings, and King Bṛhadbala —

sanskrit: pauṇḍrako vāsudevaś ca vaṅgaḥ kāliṅgakas tathā ākarṣaḥ kuntalaś caiva vānavāsyāndhrakās tathā
english: Pauṇḍraka Vāsudeva, the king of Vaṅga, the king of Kaliṅga, Ākarṣa, Kuntala, the Vānavāsyas, and the Andhraka peoples —

sanskrit: draviḍāḥ siṃhalāś caiva rājā kāśmīrakas tathā kuntibhojo mahātejāḥ suhmaś ca sumahābalaḥ
english: The Draviḍas, the Siṃhalas, the king of Kāśmīra, Kuntibhoja of great splendour, and Suhma of exceeding might —

sanskrit: bāhlikāś cāpare śūrā rājānaḥ sarva eva te virāṭaḥ saha putraiś ca mācellaś ca mahārathaḥ rājāno rājaputrāś ca nānājanapadeśvarāḥ
english: And other heroic Bāhlika kings, all of them; Virāṭa with his sons, Mācella the great chariot-warrior, kings and princes, lords of various peoples —

sanskrit: śiśupālo mahāvīryaḥ saha putreṇa bhārata āgacchat pāṇḍaveyasya yajñaṃ saṃgrāmadurmadaḥ
english: Śiśupāla of great prowess, intoxicated in battle, came with his son, O Bhārata, to the sacrifice of the son of Pāṇḍu.

sanskrit: rāmaś caivāniruddhaś ca babhruś ca sahasāraṇaḥ gadapradyumnasāmbāś ca cārudeṣṇaś ca vīryavān
english: Rāma and Aniruddha, Babhru and Sāraṇa, Gada, Pradyumna, Sāmba, and the valiant Cārudeṣṇa —

sanskrit: ulmuko niśaṭhaś caiva vīraḥ prādyumnir eva ca vṛṣṇayo nikhilenānye samājagmur mahārathāḥ
english: Ulmuka, Niśaṭha, the valiant Prādyumni — all the other Vṛṣṇi great chariot-warriors came together.

sanskrit: ete cānye ca bahavo rājāno madhyadeśajāḥ ājagmuḥ pāṇḍuputrasya rājasūyaṃ mahākratum
english: These and many other kings from the middle land came to the great imperial sacrifice of the son of Pāṇḍu.

sanskrit: dadus teṣām āvasathān dharmarājasya śāsanāt bahukakṣyānvitān rājan dīrghikāvṛkṣaśobhitān
english: By the command of the Dharma-king, O king, they were given lodgings with many courtyards, adorned with ponds and trees.

sanskrit: tathā dharmātmajas teṣāṃ cakre pūjām anuttamām satkṛtāś ca yathoddiṣṭāñ jagmur āvasathān nṛpāḥ
english: The son of Dharma also accorded them the highest honour; duly honoured, the kings went to the lodgings assigned to them.

sanskrit: kailāsaśikharaprakhyān manojñān dravyabhūṣitān sarvataḥ saṃvṛtān uccaiḥ prākāraiḥ sukṛtaiḥ sitaiḥ
english: Like the peaks of Kailāsa, delightful, adorned with precious things, enclosed on all sides by lofty, well-built, white ramparts —

sanskrit: suvarṇajālasaṃvītān maṇikuṭṭimaśobhitān sukhārohaṇasopānān mahāsanaparicchadān
english: — latticed with nets of gold, beautiful with floors inlaid with gems, with easy stairways to ascend, furnished with great couches and coverings —

sanskrit: sragdāmasamavacchannān uttamāgurugandhinaḥ haṃsāṃśuvarṇasadṛśān āyojanasudarśanān
english: — covered with garlands and festoons, fragrant with the finest aguru incense, white as the radiance of swans, visible for a league around —

sanskrit: asaṃbādhān samadvārān yutān uccāvacair guṇaiḥ bahudhātupinaddhāṅgān himavacchikharān iva
english: — unencumbered, with level gateways, possessed of qualities both great and small, their walls inlaid with many minerals, like the peaks of the Himālaya —

sanskrit: viśrāntās te tato 'paśyan bhūmipā bhūridakṣiṇam vṛtaṃ sadasyair bahubhir dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
english: Having rested, the lords of the earth then beheld the Dharma-king Yudhiṣṭhira, the generous giver, surrounded by many assembly-members.

sanskrit: tat sadaḥ pārthivaiḥ kīrṇaṃ brāhmaṇaiś ca mahātmabhiḥ bhrājate sma tadā rājan nākapṛṣṭham ivāmaraiḥ
english: That assembly, filled with kings and great-souled brāhmaṇas, shone then, O king, like the summit of heaven filled with immortals.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca pitāmahaṃ guruṃ caiva pratyudgamya yudhiṣṭhiraḥ abhivādya tato rājann idaṃ vacanam abravīt bhīṣmaṃ droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ drauṇiṃ duryodhanaviviṃśatī
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Going forward to receive his grandsire and preceptor, Yudhiṣṭhira bowed and then, O king, spoke these words to Bhīṣma, Droṇa, Kṛpa, Drauṇi, and Duryodhana together with Viviṃśati:

sanskrit: asmin yajñe bhavanto mām anugṛhṇantu sarvaśaḥ idaṃ vaḥ svam ahaṃ caiva yad ihāsti dhanaṃ mama prīṇayantu bhavanto māṃ yatheṣṭam aniyantritāḥ
english: "May all of you grace me entirely at this sacrifice. This wealth here is yours as much as mine — may you please me as you wish, unconstrained."

sanskrit: evam uktvā sa tān sarvān dīkṣitaḥ pāṇḍavāgrajaḥ yuyoja ha yathāyogam adhikāreṣv anantaram
english: Having spoken thus to all of them, the initiated eldest son of Pāṇḍu then assigned each of them straightaway to offices according to their fitness.

sanskrit: bhakṣyabhojyādhikāreṣu duḥśāsanam ayojayat parigrahe brāhmaṇānām aśvatthāmānam uktavān
english: He appointed Duḥśāsana to oversee the distribution of food and eatables; and he told Aśvatthāmā to take charge of the reception of the brāhmaṇas.
